title: StateChange missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: Every other public struct in this crate (Session, AccountInfo, WebSocketCapability, BlobUploadResponse, ClientConfig, SseFrame) is marked #[non_exhaustive]. StateChange in push.rs is not. The JMAP Chat extension and future JMAP drafts may add fields to the StateChange object. Without #[non_exhaustive], any such addition is a semver-breaking change. Maintenance consequence: adding a field to StateChange breaks all external callers doing struct literal construction.
